content.title: Who am I?
content.description: Developer and digital consultant based in Sweden. I started in sales and marketing, so I build software with the business case in view — not just the ticket. I'm at my best where technology and business meet: hands-on coding, or helping organizations make sense of their digital transformation.

content.title: My Journey
content.description: AI is part of my daily workflow — not to ship faster noise, but to spend my hours on the decisions that matter: architecture, UX and the actual business problem. This site was designed and built that way.
